messages:
maria.k: quick sync — I ran the audit-coverage scanner across prod slices and we have multiple gaps that affect customer-facing evidence. main areas: api-gateway missing request_id on some auth flows, runtime missing token refresh and kv-cache access events, and billing/console not emitting admin_policy_change events consistently. we should triage and create backlog tickets.

security-bot: automated-scan: 2026-03-20 14:12Z — 98 services scanned, 6 high gaps, 12 medium. top gaps: api-gateway (missing request_id, missing downstream.user_id), runtime (auth.token.refresh not emitted), console UI (admin policy change events absent when RBAC role X modified). full CSV uploaded to /shared/sec/audit-scans/scan-2419876543.csv

alex.g: can you paste an example of the missing event vs expected schema? makes it easier to map to producer code.

maria.k: sure — example of what we expect (schema v2):
```json
{
  "event_type": "auth.token.refresh",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T13:45:21Z",
  "request_id": "req_01F...",
  "user_id": "acct_1234",
  "actor": { "id": "svc-gateway", "type": "service" },
  "metadata": { "reason": "refresh_after_expiry" }
}
```
Observed in runtime logs (what we currently see):
```json
{
  "event_type": "auth.token.refresh",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T13:45:21Z",
  "user_id": "acct_1234",
  "metadata": { "reason": "refresh_after_expiry" }
}
```
Missing `request_id` and `actor` fields — makes cross-service tracing and customer evidence impossible.

sam.t: this aligns with the RBAC refactor we did in Nov 2025 — we toggled a middleware chain to short-circuit auth logging for performance in hot paths. looks like the middleware no longer injects request_id into the token refresh path. iirc the change was in runtime-auth middleware: `auth-logger.go` around `HandleRefreshToken`. i'll own a quick patch to re-instrument.

vinh.n: billing/console gap: when an org admin updates billing contact or payment method via console v2, we get a `console.ui.action` event but not the richer `admin_policy_change` or `billing.contact.change` events. repro steps: login -> org settings -> billing -> change card -> confirm. event seen in frontend devtools: `console.ui.action` only. backend handler `billing-service` isn't emitting the structured audit event. owner likely payments team.

jenny.z: two asks: 1) can we create a customer-facing validation harness that runs replayed flows and verifies event schema and presence (like a small contract test)? 2) we should add schema regression alerts so any producer that strips required fields triggers a regression.

alex.g: +1 on harness. propose a lightweight runner that: replays 50 canonical flows (auth refresh, api call with api-key, admin role change, billing update, kms key rotate), checks event presence and fields, and emits pass/fail per-flow. run nightly against staging and weekly on prod sampling.

maria.k: jenny — can you draft the harness checklist? alex/sam/vinh — can you add one ticket each for your areas with an acceptance criteria that includes the harness gating?

jenny.z: drafting now. checklist initial items: 1) define canonical flows & owners, 2) expected event schema per flow (field list + types), 3) replay harness + CI integration plan, 4) customer evidence export (signed bundle with request_id traces), 5) runbook for incidents where evidence is missing. will share PR with JSON schema defs.

sam.t: created runtime ticket (#RT-4821) — patch to auth-logger, add request_id injection + actor enrichment. acceptance: sample token.refresh events include request_id and actor fields, and end-to-end trace links in the console evidence bundle. ETA EOD tomorrow.

vinh.n: created billing ticket (#PAY-2913) — ensure billing-service emits `billing.contact.change` + `admin_policy_change` where applicable. acceptance: console flow produces both frontend `console.ui.action` and backend structured events with request_id. assigned to @payments-backend. ETA 3 days.

alex.g: I'll drop a tiny probe tool into api-gateway that asserts presence of request_id in outgoing events and emits a metric `audit.event.missing_request_id`. we can alert if rate > 0.1% over 5m. ticket #GW-1099.

security-bot: note: KMS integration check — logs must include key_id and operation for `kms.wrap` and `kms.unwrap` events. current scan flagged missing `key_id` for some wrap events in private-deploy pipelines.

maria.k: good catch. sam/vinh — does this affect the runtime KMS wrapper or the deploy pipeline?

sam.t: likely runtime wrapper for client-side encryption paths. will add explicit key_id logging and map to KMS audit event schema.

jenny.z: for customer validation we should also produce an HMAC-signed evidence bundle that includes the sequence of events per request_id and a hash of the model of the schema used. I'll include that in the harness spec.

maria.k: summary / next steps:
- owners: runtime -> @sam.t, billing -> @vinh.n, gateway -> @alex.g, harness spec -> @jenny.z
- tickets: RT-4821, PAY-2913, GW-1099 (links in #tickets channel)
- acceptance: every canonical flow has a request_id, actor, and required schema fields; nightly harness must run in staging, weekly prod sample; alerts for schema regression
- follow-up sync: 2026-03-21 14:00 UTC (30m) to validate fixes and demo harness prototype.

please reply with blockers or if you need more context. :eyes:
